unit: Displacement Research and Action Network (DRAN), Department of Urban Studies and Planning

labs.pi_title: Founder, DRAN; Professor of Law and Development, MIT DUSP; UN Special Rapporteur on the Right to Adequate Housing
labs.location: MIT Department of Urban Studies and Planning, 105 Massachusetts Avenue, Cambridge, MA 02139
labs.research_summary: A global network on displacement and land rights, researching the causes and consequences of mass internal displacement from development, conflict and climate disaster and working to influence law and policy.
